note: ROOT-RULINGS R-4 on Linux in Docker (node:20, the BUILD-PLAN §5.4 MX-06 image: perl 5.36 and ps; offline, read-only root, a tmpfs /tmp, the plugin's helper/ mounted read-only): identity::start_time of a live pid equals `ps -o lstart=` and the fork's second, and stays the same while the process allocates 3 x 32 MiB (its /proc field 23 grows). Before the fix it read field 23, so the start time moved with memory. Skips unless Docker answers and holds the image (no pull).
